title: Shared definitions for the Compound Policy Check data files

casrn.description: CAS Registry Number. The check digit is verified separately.

hCode.description: A single H code or a combination such as H302+H312.

pCode.description: A single P code or a combination such as P305+P351+P338.

pictogram.description: GHS pictogram code; a file with this name must exist in docs/assets/pictograms.

localizedText.description: A text in every supported language.

meta.description: Where the data comes from and how current it is.

updatedAt.description: Date of the last update, as YYYY-MM-DD.

publishedAt.description: Local date and time of publication of the source, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.
